english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone gives focused attention while listening, watching, or doing something.
Use this when the emphasis is on paying close attention or concentrating on the task.

examples.english: Listen attentively to what I’m saying first.
examples.jyutping: zyun1 sam1 gam3 teng1 zyu6 ngo5 gong2 sin1

examples.english: I conscientiously paid close attention to the teacher’s explanation in class.
examples.traditional: 上堂嗰陣，我專心咁聽老師講解。
examples.jyutping: soeng5 tong4 go2 zan6 ngo5 zyun1 sam1 gam3 teng1 lou5 si1 gong2 gaai2
